name: Scape
summary: AI desktop email client that prioritizes your inbox, prepares contextual drafts and records meetings locally.
description: Scape is a desktop email client that uses context from email, meeting transcripts, calendar and attachments to surface what matters and prepare replies you review and send. It records meetings locally on Mac without a bot joining, in 99 languages, and keeps customer conversations organized. Free plan ($0, unlimited inboxes); Plus $20/month; Max $100/month.
features: local meeting recording (Meet, Teams, FaceTime, in person)
